tree.label: Community AI
tree.definition: Artificial intelligence as built and used, language models, prompts, agents and the systems made from them.

children.label: Language Models
children.definition: The models themselves, which model, at which size and quantization, and how it writes and behaves before any agent is built around it.

children.label: Local Models
children.definition: Running open models on one's own machine, engines, quants, windows and speed.

children.label: Model Behaviour
children.definition: How a model writes and acts, its register, its humanlikeness, its following of instructions, measured across models.

children.label: Interpretability
children.definition: Seeing inside a model, token probabilities, alternatives, activations and weights.

children.label: Prompt Engineering
children.definition: The writing of prompts and of the languages prompts are written in.

children.label: Prompt Languages
children.definition: Languages made for writing prompts, their syntax, semantics and tooling.

children.label: Smile
children.definition: The Smile Prompt Language, Smile Chat and their tools.

children.label: Prompts
children.definition: Whole prompts offered to use, each a finished piece of writing for a model.

children.label: Prompt Evaluation
children.definition: Measuring what a prompt does, with and without it, across models, by program or by judge.

children.label: Agents
children.definition: Language models given a loop, tools, memory and a role, alone or many together.

children.label: Agent Definitions
children.definition: What an agent, agency and agentiality are, and where an agent's boundary lies.

children.label: Agent Engineering
children.definition: Building one agent, its harness, scaffold, memory and subagents.

children.label: Multi-Agent Systems
children.definition: Many agents working as one system, each with a unique contribution.

children.label: Ganapati
children.definition: Ganapati and the Gana, the local hivemind of his own work.

children.label: AI Companions
children.definition: Agents that keep company with a person, friends that text, with their own pace, writing and memory.

children.label: AI Friends
children.definition: Low-contact Louie, Juniper, Pip, Olive and Wren, and their trials.

tree.label: Bodhisattva Practice
tree.definition: The dharma as practised, translated and made visible.

children.label: Practice
children.definition: What is done, sitting, contemplating, vowing, living in a monastery.

children.label: Insight Contemplation
children.definition: Contemplation into the nature of reality, all day and every day.

children.label: Monastic Life
children.definition: Ordination, robes and the monastery day.

children.label: Bodhisattva Vow
children.definition: The vow to benefit all beings, taken and lived, by people and by AI.

children.label: Texts
children.definition: The written dharma, read and carried into other languages.

children.label: Translations
children.definition: Ancient texts carried into English, with or without AI.

children.label: Sacred Arts
children.definition: The dharma made visible, forms, proportions and symbols.

children.label: Sacred Geometry
children.definition: The forms beneath the forms, drawn, generated and built.

children.label: Symbols
children.definition: The wheel, the lotus, the stupa and the other symbols of the dharma, and what they carry.

format.definition: What kind of piece the post is.

values.definition: A precise answer to what a thing is.
values.tool: A working thing the reader uses on the page.
values.prompt: A whole prompt given to use.
values.trial: A measured comparison with hypotheses written first.
values.commentary: A reading of a text or teaching.
values.research: Original findings from data or a system built for it.
values.tutorial: Steps a reader follows to build or do something.

model.definition: Every model the post runs or measures.

tool.definition: Languages, libraries and programs the post builds with.

method.definition: How the post finds what it finds.

values.with-and-without-prompt: The same model run with a prompt and without it.
values.program-measured: Measures computed by program, never by a model.
values.engine-tokenizer: Tokens counted by the engine that reads them.
values.simulation: Futures rolled forward from recorded states.
values.a-b-drawing: A diagram drawn with and without an instruction and measured.

project.definition: His named bodies of work the post belongs to or uses.

practice.definition: The practice a Buddhism post concerns, or an AI post draws on.

level.definition: Who the post is written for.

values.beginner: Someone meeting the subject for the first time.
values.engineer: Someone who will run the code and read the numbers.

evidence.definition: How what the post says is backed.

values.measured: Numbers from runs, with the data published.
values.built: A working system the reader can run.

sort.evidence: Measured, then built, then experienced, then argued.
sort.depth: The most specific place first, for a search that names a subject.
